drop_separator_round.note: Presented as removing a redundant round ('x^0 == x', as the comment says); the separator round shifts the state as well as xoring, so dropping it changes every checksum and no valid address encodes or decodes.

mask_data_bytes.note: Presented as replacing a bounds check with a branch-free table index (b&31); data bytes of 32 or more are now silently truncated into valid-looking strings instead of failing with ErrInvalidDataByte. No upstream test encodes an out-of-range data byte.

index_string.note: Presented as a simpler lookup in toBytes (strings.Index over a one-character string); it allocates a string per character and goes through the general substring search instead of IndexByte, so decoding does more work.
